_description: Audit ledger behind scripts/coverage_gate.py. One entry per active registry utility: when its published classes were last audited (class-level reconciliation), what is deliberately excluded, what is blocked by the source, what is deferred (an open item that fails the gate) and what is monitored (with a review_by date). Items quote the maintained tables in docs/phase5_completion_matrix.md. An entry never changes a rate: the registry and scrapers decide what is live.

audit.basis: Dry run of all 47 active Ontario distributors with the date set to 2026-11-01 (the OEB RPP page already lists prices effective 2026-11-01 and the parser rejects a future date), simulating the scheduled November 1 scrape: 490 live records, equal to the stored export, no errors. Every in-scope class in an approved tariff either yields a live record or is a recorded parser rejection (fail-closed). Rejections: Oakville GS<50 and Algoma's by-design absent GS classes. The only non-live record per distributor is the labelled street-lighting estimate (an excluded class); GrandBridge and Enova have none.
audit.source: docs/phase5_completion_matrix.md, Ontario Registry Inventory; docs/live_parser_gap_report.md, Ontario Distributors
